requirements.raw_text: The system shall accept username between 3 and 20 characters
requirements.title: Username length validation (3-20 characters)

data_ranges: username: length between 3 and 20 characters, non-empty
conditions: System is ready to accept username input

requirements.raw_text: The system shall accept password between 8 and 32 characters with at least one digit
requirements.title: Password complexity validation (8-32 chars, at least one digit)

data_ranges: password: must contain at least one digit
conditions: System is ready to accept password input
expected_actions: Accept password meeting length and digit requirement
Reject password without at least one digit

requirements.raw_text: Empty username shall show error message username is required
requirements.title: Empty username error message

conditions: User submits the login form with username field empty

requirements.raw_text: Empty password shall show error message password is required
requirements.title: Empty password error message

conditions: User submits the login form with password field empty

requirements.raw_text: Valid credentials user01 and Pass1234 shall redirect to success page
requirements.title: Login with valid credentials redirects to success page

conditions: User submits login form with username 'user01' and password 'Pass1234'

requirements.raw_text: Invalid credentials shall show error invalid credentials
requirements.title: Error message for invalid credentials

data_ranges: username: any value not part of valid credentials
password: any value not matching the corresponding valid password
conditions: User submits login form with credentials that do not match any valid account

requirements.raw_text: After three failed login attempts the account shall be locked for 30 seconds
requirements.title: Account lock after 3 failed login attempts

conditions: Three consecutive failed login attempts occur for the same account
expected_actions: Prevent further login attempts during the lock period

risks.reason: Username length validation with boundary constraints (3,20) increases failure probability; moderate business impact as it affects user input integrity; failure is easily detectable.

Security-sensitive password rule with multiple constraints (length, digit) raises failure probability; accepting invalid passwords could allow weak credentials, raising business impact; detectability is moderate.
Low-impact error message for empty username; simple condition has low failure probability; omission of error message is immediately detectable.
Similar to REQ-003: empty password error has low business impact, low failure probability, and is easily detectable.
Core login success flow; high business impact if redirection fails; integration complexity contributes to moderate failure probability; failure is obvious to testers.
Invalid credentials error message; moderate business impact if feedback is missing; multiple invalid combinations increase test complexity; failure is visible.

Critical security lockout mechanism prevents brute force; failure would have high impact on user accounts; complex stateful logic (counter, timer) significantly raises failure probability; silent failure possible.

coverage_items.description: Valid passwords: 8-32 characters, at least one digit
Invalid credentials: any pair not matching valid credentials
Boundary: password length = min-1 (7 chars) with digit
Boundary: password length = min (8 chars) with digit
Boundary: password length = min+1 (9 chars) with digit
Boundary: password length = max-1 (31 chars) with digit
Boundary: password length = max (32 chars) with digit
Boundary: password length = max+1 (33 chars) with digit
Boundary: password contains 0 digits (just outside constraint)
Boundary: password contains 1 digit (just inside constraint)
Boundary: failed attempts count = max-1 (2, no lock)
Boundary: failed attempts count = max (3, lockout triggered)
Boundary: failed attempts count = max+1 (4, during lockout)
Rule R2: C1=Y,C2=N → A2 (username invalid length)
Rule R4: C1=Y,C2=Y,C3=Y,C4=N → A4 (password invalid length)
Rule R7: C1=Y,C2=Y,C3=Y,C4=Y,C5=Y,C6=N,C7=N → A7 (invalid credentials, lock if counter reaches 3)

test_cases.title: EP-valid username within range
test_cases.preconditions: User is on the login page
test_cases.expected: No error message about username length; if credentials invalid, error 'invalid credentials' displayed (username length validation passed).

test_cases.title: EP-username too short
test_cases.preconditions: User is on the login page
test_cases.expected: Error message indicating invalid username (e.g., 'Username must be at least 3 characters') is displayed. Login not performed.

test_cases.title: EP-username too long
test_cases.preconditions: User is on the login page
steps: Enter 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstu' (21 characters) in the username field
test_cases.expected: Error message indicating invalid username (e.g., 'Username must be at most 20 characters') is displayed. Login not performed.

test_cases.title: EP-empty username
test_cases.preconditions: User is on the login page
test_cases.expected: Error message 'username is required' displayed. Login not performed.

test_cases.title: EP-valid password within range and digit
test_cases.preconditions: User is on the login page
test_cases.expected: No error message about password format; if credentials invalid, error 'invalid credentials' displayed (password format validation passed).

test_cases.title: EP-empty password
test_cases.preconditions: User is on the login page
test_cases.expected: Error message 'password is required' displayed. Login not performed.

test_cases.title: EP-password too short
test_cases.preconditions: User is on the login page
steps: Enter 'Pass1' (5 characters, contains digit) in the password field
test_cases.expected: Error message indicating invalid password (e.g., 'Password must be at least 8 characters') displayed. Login not performed.

test_cases.title: EP-password too long
test_cases.preconditions: User is on the login page
steps: Enter '123456789012345678901234567890123' (33 characters, digits only) in the password field
test_cases.expected: Error message indicating invalid password (e.g., 'Password must be at most 32 characters') displayed. Login not performed.

test_cases.title: EP-password missing digit
test_cases.preconditions: User is on the login page
steps: Enter 'Password' (8 characters, no digit) in the password field
test_cases.expected: Error message indicating invalid password (e.g., 'Password must contain at least one digit') displayed. Login not performed.

test_cases.title: EP-valid credentials login success
test_cases.preconditions: User is on the login page; account not locked
test_cases.expected: Redirect to success page.

test_cases.title: EP-invalid credentials
test_cases.preconditions: User is on the login page
test_cases.expected: Error message 'invalid credentials' displayed. Login denied.

test_cases.title: EP-less than 3 failed attempts no lock
test_cases.preconditions: Account not locked. User is on the login page.
steps: Attempt 1: Enter 'user01' in username and 'wrongpass' in password, click Login, observe 'invalid credentials' error.
Attempt 2: Enter 'user01' in username and 'wrongpass' in password, click Login, observe 'invalid credentials' error.
Attempt valid: Enter 'user01' in username and 'Pass1234' in password, click Login.
test_cases.expected: After 2 failed attempts, login with valid credentials succeeds, redirect to success page.

test_cases.title: EP-exactly 3 failed attempts triggers lock
test_cases.preconditions: Account not locked. User is on the login page.
steps: Attempt 1: Enter 'user01' in username and 'wrongpass' in password, click Login, observe 'invalid credentials' error.
Attempt 2: Repeat with same invalid credentials, observe 'invalid credentials' error.
Attempt 3: Repeat with same invalid credentials, observe 'invalid credentials' error.
Attempt valid: Enter 'user01' in username and 'Pass1234' in password, click Login.
test_cases.expected: After third failed attempt, account is locked. On the valid login attempt, error message indicating account is locked (e.g., 'Account locked due to too many failed attempts. Try again in 30 seconds.') is displayed. Redirect does not occur.
